name: Estonia
contextBlurb: Estonia moved from a national virtual-asset service provider regime into the EU MiCA framework. Stablecoins are legal with restrictions when structured as MiCA-compliant EMTs or ARTs, with licensing, reserve, redemption, disclosure and AML controls. The Finantsinspektsioon is the core financial supervisor for MiCA activity.

legislation.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
legislation.summary: EU regime for stablecoin issuance and crypto-asset service provision, directly applicable in Estonia.

news.headline: MiCA authorisation and crypto-asset services information

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Estonia follows MiCA. Stablecoins are legal with restrictions and require EU-compliant authorisation, reserves, redemption rights, disclosure and AML controls.

regulators.name: Finantsinspektsioon
regulators.role: Estonian financial supervisor for MiCA authorisations and regulated crypto-asset services.
